cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility via Button
cases.description: Preconditions: The Speech Text Reader application is loaded and the text box (data-testid="text-box") is initially hidden. Steps: Click the "Toggle Text Box" button (data-testid="toggle-button"). Expected Behavior: The text box appears with the 'show' class applied. Clicking the button again hides the text box by removing the 'show' class, reflecting the last user action accurately.

cases.title: Close Text Box Using Close Button
cases.description: Preconditions: The text box (data-testid="text-box") is currently visible after clicking the toggle button. Steps: Click the 'Close' button (data-testid="close-button") located inside the visible text box. Expected Behavior: The text box is hidden by removing the 'show' class from the text box element in the DOM.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Text Box Open
cases.description: Preconditions: The text box is initially hidden. Steps: Click the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') to make the text box visible. Expected Behavior: The system invokes getVoices and populates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with option elements containing voice names and languages from the Web Speech API.

cases.title: Select Voice with Language Code from Dropdown
cases.description: Preconditions: The voice dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') is populated with available voices. Steps: Select a voice option containing a specific language code such as 'CN' or 'US'. Expected Behavior: The system accurately sets the selected voice containing the language code as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Read Entered Text Aloud Using Selected Voice
cases.description: Preconditions: The text box is open, a voice is selected in the dropdown (data-testid='voice-select'), and text is entered into the textarea (data-testid='text-area'). Steps: Click the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'). Expected Behavior: The system reads the entered text aloud using the selected voice via the Web Speech API.

cases.title: Interact with Predefined Phrase Box for Speech and Highlight
cases.description: Preconditions: The web application is loaded with dynamically generated predefined phrase boxes containing images and info paragraphs. Steps: Click on one of the predefined phrase boxes. Expected Behavior: The system reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds.

opinions.feedback: All cases are fully grounded in the provided requirements, with valid preconditions, actionable steps, and clear expected behaviors.

analysis.analysis: Analyzed requirements e2edev_bench_04-R-1 through e2edev_bench_04-R-6. Created focused test scenarios covering normal toggling, close button visibility/interaction, voice dropdown population, voice selection with language codes, text-to-speech reading via textarea and read button, and predefined phrase box interactions including speech playback and active class toggling.
